about: Real exercise videos used to test the rep counters. The videos are not stored here: scripts/extract-fixtures.mjs downloads them, runs the app's pose model on them, and saves only the body-dot numbers to tests/fixtures/. Rep counts were labelled by hand.

clips.title: Man doing push-ups in the gym, camera on the floor in front
clips.note: Phone very close and low: the shoulder drop looks small, the elbows carry it. About 10 reps; the last may not finish inside the clip.

clips.title: Young man doing push-ups on a balcony, camera in front
Woman doing push-ups, ground view from the front
clips.note: The clip opens mid-movement with a few bad frames, so the first rep may be missed.

clips.title: Strong woman doing push-ups in the gym, close front view
clips.note: A fourth rep starts but the clip ends at the bottom.

clips.title: Young man doing push-ups, very close front view
clips.note: Too close: only the head and part of the arms are in view. Not labelled; used to check nothing silly happens.

clips.title: Woman doing push-ups on a step, front view
Woman doing push-ups, side view
Man doing push-ups outdoors, side view
clips.note: A fifth rep starts but the clip ends before the top.

clips.title: Man doing push-ups outdoors, three-quarter view
Woman doing push-ups, three-quarter view
clips.note: Goes straight into the first rep with no pause at the top, so a counter started on the very first frame may miss it.

clips.title: Man doing push-ups on a balcony, side view at a distance
clips.note: The sixth rep is still rising when the clip ends.

clips.title: Father and son doing push-ups, side view
clips.note: Two people side by side. The tracker cannot keep them apart, so this only checks that it never over-counts. The app asks for one person in view.

clips.title: Man running towards the camera (not a push-up)
clips.note: Running, not push-ups: must count zero.

clips.title: Woman doing squats at the gym, facing the camera
Woman doing squats at the gym, facing the camera, closer
clips.note: A second squat starts as the clip ends.

clips.title: Woman doing squats at the gym, facing the camera, far away
clips.note: Starts at the bottom of a squat; far from the camera.

clips.title: Women doing squats with a ball, side view
clips.note: Counted after the start gate: she only stands still after two squats.

clips.title: Woman doing squats in a kitchen, three-quarter view
clips.note: Counted after the start gate: the first squat comes before she stands still.

clips.title: Man doing squats at home, side view, legs partly out of frame
clips.note: Starts mid-squat with the feet partly out of frame; counted after the start gate.

clips.title: Woman doing squats with a coach beside her
clips.note: A coach kneels right beside her.

clips.title: Woman doing squats with a ball, facing the camera, far away
clips.note: Starts at the bottom of a squat; far from the camera; holding a ball.
